reason: After overtime I lie there 30-40 minutes, and timer apps cut out right when I'm drifting off, so a fade that follows when I put the phone down actually fits my messy schedule. The trial costs nothing and doesn't auto-charge, so I'd try it, and if the 14-day comparison shows I fall asleep faster I'd pay the 4,900 won monthly, not the yearly one.
objection: I don't believe a phone on the bed can really tell when I fell asleep or woke up. If the numbers in the comparison are just guesses, the whole 'proof' is meaningless and it's one more sleep app I'll stop opening.
would_change_my_mind: If the day-14 comparison shows no real difference, or the sleep times it records are obviously wrong compared to what I remember, I won't pay.
